calls.statement:
SELECT MAX(calendar_date) as max_date, MIN(calendar_date) as min_date
FROM dim_date

SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date >= '2026-09-15' AND calendar_date <= '2026-10-04'
ORDER BY fiscal_week_end_date DESC
LIMIT 5

calls.statement:
SELECT product_key, sku, product_name
FROM dim_product
WHERE product_name LIKE '%Kaakkuri%' AND is_current = TRUE

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_week,
  d.fiscal_week_start_date,
  d.fiscal_week_end_date,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE p.sku = 101624 
  AND d.fiscal_week = 22
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
calls.output_preview:
fiscal_year | fiscal_week | fiscal_week_start_date | fiscal_week_end_date | units_sold
FY2026/27 | 22 | 2026-09-28 | 2026-10-04 | 183
(1 row)
